name: Cuda

attributes.attribute: a British goddess found at Cirencester
token of promise and fertile life
shown seated and holding the egg

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Cuda is a little-known British goddess. Seated figures hold an egg at Cirencester, the old town of the Dobunni tribe. That egg is read as a token of promise and fertile life.

okr.objective: Cuda is a minor goddess of the Dobunni who holds a token of promise.
key_results: Found in Cirencester near the seat of the Dobunni.
Depicted seated with an egg in hand.
The egg signals promise and fertile life.
okr.evidence: Monaghan, Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore
